items.title: Frank Wess — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Well, different people. I have a lot of different bass players. David Wong, the French trumpet player, Fabian.

ctx.x: Well, different people. I have a lot of different bass players. David Wong, the French trumpet player, Fabian. I don’t know, some Israeli bass players, Atell Ronan, Yonatan, a lot of them. Atai, you’ve never heard of Atai, but he’s a fabulous jazz flutist. You wouldn’t believe him if you heard him.
Jimmy Heath was talking about David Wong.
